blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo Lacson on Wednesday urged Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp to “rectify an obviously misleading figure of P500 million,” which the Senate supposedly spent on two of the three withdrawn articles of impeachment against her. According to Lacson, the General Appropriations Act allotted only P27 million for the impeachment trial. “The P25M per day used by Spox Panelo (Duterte’s spokesperson Atty. Paolo Panelo Jr.) actually refers to the Senate’s legislative functions, which I computed on a per-day basis using the annual MOOE (maintenance and other operating expenses) and PS (personnel services), etc.,” he said in a Viber […]...
